points.title: 法律学者时期
points.description: 康定斯基出生于莫斯科一个富裕的商人家庭，最初学习法律和经济学，并获得博士学位。在莫斯科大学期间，他对艺术产生了浓厚兴趣，特别是受到莫奈作品的影响。1896年，30岁的康定斯基毅然放弃法律事业，前往慕尼黑学习绘画，这一决定彻底改变了他的人生轨迹，标志着他从学者向艺术家的转变。
points.descriptionEn: Kandinsky was born in Moscow to a wealthy merchant family. Initially, he studied law and economics, earning a doctorate. During his time at Moscow University, he developed a keen interest in art, particularly influenced by Monet's works. In 1896, at the age of 30, Kandinsky decisively abandoned his legal career and moved to Munich to study painting, a decision that completely transformed his life path and marked his transition from scholar to artist.

points.title: 表现主义探索
points.description: 在慕尼黑，康定斯基进入艺术学院学习，并很快成为表现主义运动的核心人物。1901年，他共同创立了艺术家团体'Phalanx'，并举办了自己的第一次个人画展。1903年开始，他广泛游历欧洲，受到多种艺术流派影响。1909年，他加入'新艺术家联盟'，1911年与弗朗茨·马尔克共同创立了著名的'蓝骑士'团体，发表《论艺术的精神》一书，奠定了抽象艺术的理论基础。
points.descriptionEn: In Munich, Kandinsky entered the art academy and quickly became a central figure in the Expressionist movement. In 1901, he co-founded the artist group 'Phalanx' and held his first solo exhibition. From 1903, he extensively traveled throughout Europe, influenced by various art movements. In 1909, he joined the 'New Artists' Association,' and in 1911, co-founded the famous 'Blue Rider' group with Franz Marc, publishing his seminal book 'Concerning the Spiritual in Art,' which laid the theoretical foundation for abstract art.

points.title: 蓝骑士时期
points.description: 在慕尼黑，康定斯基与马尔克共同领导'蓝骑士'运动，这是20世纪最具影响力的艺术团体之一。这一时期，康定斯基的艺术风格逐渐从具象转向抽象，创作了《构图》系列作品。他组织了两次'蓝骑士'展览，展示了包括他自己、马尔克、克利、马列维奇等艺术家的作品。这一时期的思想交流极大地促进了现代艺术的发展，康定斯基的理论著作《论艺术的精神》也在此期间完成，强调艺术应表达内在精神而非外在形式。
points.descriptionEn: In Munich, Kandinsky co-led the 'Blue Rider' movement with Marc, one of the most influential art groups of the 20th century. During this period, Kandinsky's artistic style gradually shifted from figurative to abstract, creating his 'Composition' series. He organized two 'Blue Rider' exhibitions, showcasing works by himself, Marc, Klee, Malevich, and others. The intellectual exchange during this time greatly promoted the development of modern art, and Kandinsky's theoretical work 'Concerning the Spiritual in Art' was completed, emphasizing that art should express inner spirit rather than external form.

points.title: 俄国革命时期
points.description: 第一次世界大战爆发后，康定斯基被迫返回莫斯科。俄国革命后，他积极参与艺术教育工作，担任莫斯科人民文化教育委员会的艺术部门负责人，并参与建立莫斯科艺术学院和俄罗斯博物馆。他尝试将艺术与社会主义理念结合，发展'客观艺术'理论。然而，他对苏联官方艺术政策逐渐感到失望，特别是对社会主义现实主义的不满，这促使他最终决定离开俄国，重返西方艺术界。
points.descriptionEn: With the outbreak of World War I, Kandinsky was forced to return to Moscow. After the Russian Revolution, he actively participated in art education, serving as head of the art department of the People's Commissariat for Enlightenment, and helped establish the Moscow Art Academy and the Russian Museum. He attempted to combine art with socialist ideals, developing his theory of 'objective art.' However, he became increasingly disillusioned with Soviet official art policies, particularly with socialist realism, which eventually led him to leave Russia and return to the Western art world.

points.title: 包豪斯时期
points.description: 1922年，康定斯基接受格罗皮乌斯的邀请，加入包豪斯学校，担任壁画系主任。在德绍的包豪斯时期，他的艺术风格更加几何化和系统化，创作了著名的《构图》和《点、线、面》系列。1926年，他出版理论著作《点、线、面》，系统阐述了他的艺术理论。这一时期，他将艺术教学与创作相结合，培养了众多学生，对现代设计教育产生了深远影响。1933年，纳粹上台后，包豪斯被关闭，康定斯基被迫流亡巴黎。
points.descriptionEn: In 1922, Kandinsky accepted an invitation from Walter Gropius to join the Bauhaus school, where he served as head of the mural painting department. During his time in Dessau, his artistic style became more geometric and systematic, creating his famous 'Composition' and 'Point and Line to Plane' series. In 1926, he published his theoretical work 'Point and Line to Plane,' systematically阐述ing his art theories. During this period, he combined art teaching with creation, educating numerous students and profoundly influencing modern design education. In 1933, after the Nazi rise to power, the Bauhaus was closed, and Kandinsky was forced into exile in Paris.

points.title: 晚年抽象探索
points.description: 在巴黎的最后岁月，康定斯基的艺术风格进一步发展，融合了几何抽象与有机形态，创作了《宇宙》系列等作品。他受到超现实主义和抽象表现主义的影响，作品色彩更加明亮，形式更加自由。这一时期，他的艺术达到了新的高度，对后来的抽象表现主义产生了重要影响。尽管面临纳粹的迫害和战争的阴影，康定斯基坚持创作，直到1944年在巴黎逝世。他的晚年作品被公认为20世纪艺术的重要成就，为抽象艺术的发展做出了不可磨灭的贡献。
points.descriptionEn: In his final years in Paris, Kandinsky's artistic style further evolved, blending geometric abstraction with organic forms, creating works such as his 'Cosmic' series. He was influenced by Surrealism and Abstract Expressionism, with brighter colors and freer forms in his work. During this period, his art reached new heights and significantly influenced later Abstract Expressionism. Despite facing Nazi persecution and the shadow of war, Kandinsky continued to create until his death in Paris in 1944. His late works are widely recognized as major achievements of 20th-century art, making an indelible contribution to the development of abstract art.

supporter.zh: 康定斯基被誉为抽象艺术之父，他的理论和实践开创了艺术史的新纪元。支持者认为他成功地将艺术从具象的束缚中解放出来，探索了色彩和形式的纯粹表达，为后来的抽象艺术奠定了基础。他的《论艺术的精神》等著作深刻影响了现代艺术教育，特别是在包豪斯的教学实践，培养了整整一代艺术家和设计师。康定斯基的艺术追求超越了时代限制，至今仍激励着艺术家探索艺术的本质和可能性。
supporter.en: Kandinsky is hailed as the father of abstract art, and his theories and practices pioneered a new era in art history. Supporters believe he successfully liberated art from the constraints of representation, exploring pure expression through color and form, laying the foundation for later abstract art. His works like 'Concerning the Spiritual in Art' profoundly influenced modern art education, particularly through his teaching at the Bauhaus, educating a generation of artists and designers. Kandinsky's artistic pursuits transcended the limitations of his time and continue to inspire artists to explore the essence and possibilities of art.

critic.zh: 批评者认为康定斯基的抽象理论过于神秘主义和唯心主义，脱离了社会现实和大众审美。有人指责他的艺术过于精英化，成为少数知识分子的智力游戏，失去了与普通人的情感连接。在苏联时期，他的艺术被批评为形式主义，不符合社会主义现实主义的要求。此外，一些评论家认为他的后期作品过于形式化，缺乏早期作品中的精神深度和情感力量，显示出艺术创作中的某种衰退。
critic.en: Critics argue that Kandinsky's abstract theory is overly mystical and idealistic, disconnected from social reality and popular aesthetics. Some accuse his art of being elitist, becoming an intellectual game for a few intellectuals, losing emotional connection with ordinary people. During his Soviet period, his art was criticized as formalist, not meeting the requirements of socialist realism. Additionally, some commentators believe his later works became too formalized, lacking the spiritual depth and emotional power of his earlier pieces, suggesting a certain decline in his artistic creation.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，康定斯基被视为现代艺术转型期的关键人物，他的贡献不仅在于创作，更在于理论建构。艺术史学界普遍承认他作为抽象艺术先驱的地位，同时认识到他的思想受到通神论、俄罗斯民间艺术和多种现代艺术流派的影响。在流行文化中，康定斯基的名字已成为艺术创新的代名词，他的作品频繁出现在现代艺术展览和文化产品中。他的教育理念，特别是包豪斯时期的教学方法，至今仍在设计教育中产生深远影响，体现了艺术理论与实践的完美结合。
objective.en: From a historical and popular culture perspective, Kandinsky is regarded as a key figure in the transition of modern art, with his contributions lying not only in his creations but also in theoretical construction. Art historians widely acknowledge his status as a pioneer of abstract art while recognizing that his ideas were influenced by Theosophy, Russian folk art, and various modern art movements. In popular culture, Kandinsky's name has become synonymous with artistic innovation, and his works frequently appear in modern art exhibitions and cultural products. His educational philosophy, particularly his teaching methods during the Bauhaus period, continues to have a profound impact on design education, embodying the perfect integration of artistic theory and practice.

self.zh: 色彩是直接作用于灵魂的工具。
self.en: Color is a means of exerting a direct influence on the soul.

others.zh: 康定斯基是第一个理解并创造纯粹抽象形式的人，他解放了色彩，使其不再依附于物体。
others.en: Kandinsky was the first person to understand and create pure abstract forms, he liberated color, making it no longer dependent on objects.
